competency.header_subtitle: AI-calibrated view of your current capabilities against the competency benchmarks for your role.
competency.critical_gaps_desc: High-priority capability deficits flagged by the AI engine requiring accelerated remediation.
competency.no_critical_gaps_desc: All evaluated competencies currently satisfy or closely track required role baseline benchmarks.
competency.domain_overview_desc: Holistic competency breakdown across MoSPI statistical, technical, digital governance, and leadership domains.
competency.matrix_desc: Granular 33-competency breakdown with calibrated scores, role benchmarks, and gap deltas.
competency.xai_title: How the AI Assessed Your Competencies
competency.xai_subtitle: Explainable AI (XAI) methodology powering official MoSPI competency calibration and gap diagnosis.
competency.xai_step1_desc: Your official service records, educational qualifications, prior training history, and self-assessment feed into the baseline calibration engine.
competency.xai_step2_desc: Backend AI models evaluate demonstrated capabilities across all 33 canonical MoSPI competencies, generating calibrated scores (1.0–5.0) and confidence weights.
competency.xai_step3_desc: Calibrated proficiencies are mapped against the mandatory role benchmarks defined in the MoSPI FRAC framework for your cadre designation.
competency.xai_step4_desc: Deficits are categorized into High (≥1.5), Medium (0.5–1.5), and Low/Proficient (<0.5) to strategically prioritize development needs.
competency.xai_step5_desc: AI-generated rationales highlight why critical capability deficits matter operationally and pair them with tailored learning interventions.
competency.xai_server_note: Note: All diagnostic evaluations and score calibrations are securely computed by DAKSHA's backend P1 Competency Intelligence & FRAC rules engine.
competency.confidence_tooltip: Represents statistical confidence in the calibration based on verifiable profile evidence and assessment records, not the officer's proficiency score.
